name: VA Northern California Health Care System
description: The VA health care system for this county. Sacramento VA Medical Center (Mather), the Martinez center, and clinics across the Sacramento Valley, East Bay and far north, including Chico, Redding, Fairfield, Oakland, Yuba City and Mare Island.
next_step: Call 800-382-8387 to ask about enrolling, being assigned a clinic, or reaching your care team. Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic. Not enrolled yet? You can also call 877-222-8387 or ask your county veterans office for help applying.
constraints: Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you. Hours, services and openings vary by clinic.
Parts of Alameda, El Dorado and Placer counties are served by other VA systems; VA will tell you which one you are assigned to.
